description.value: You are a star dakeshar player, easily slipping past the opposing team to swim as many laps as possible. You have learned to use this skill in other settings. You gain the Underwater Marauder skill feat, even if you don't meet its prerequisites. If you are Tumbling Through an enemy's space while underwater, you do not consider the enemy's space to be difficult terrain. Additionally, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all Acrobatics checks made while underwater.

publication.title: Starfinder Secrets of the Swarm Adventure Path
